raw_response:
I am 78 years old. I finished primary school and then worked these fields for 55 years. My farm is 5 mu in Quzhou County. I have 3 mu in wheat-maize rotation and 2 mu in cotton. There are six people in my house. My son and daughter-in-law work in a factory in the city, so they send money home, but the farm must still produce our food and some cash.

My winter wheat is already in the ground. I sowed an improved variety, Jimai 22, last October. I put base fertilizer then — 80 jin of compound fertilizer per mu and some DAP. Now it is green-up time. Last year I used 25 jin of urea per mu at this stage and got about 430 kg per mu. This year the wheat looks a bit thin after winter, so I will put 30 jin of urea per mu now. Counting the fall fertilizer, the total nitrogen for the wheat is about 15 kg per mu, phosphorus is 6 kg, and potassium is 3 kg. I will run the well pump three times: now at green-up, once at jointing, and once at grain filling. The electricity costs about 40 yuan each time, but dry wheat is bad wheat. I already sprayed herbicide last autumn, and I will spray one more time if I see aphids. I expect 450 kg per mu.

After I harvest the wheat in early June, I will plant hybrid maize on the same 3 mu. I buy the hybrid seed from the dealer in town — about 2.5 kg per mu. I rotary till right after wheat harvest because the season is short. At planting I put 50 jin of compound fertilizer per mu. When the maize reaches the big trumpet stage, I top dress with 50 jin of urea per mu. That gives about 18 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, and 4 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate three times: after planting if needed, at tasseling, and at grain filling. I spray three times: herbicide once, and insecticide twice for corn borer. I expect 550 kg per mu.

My 2 mu of cotton gets planted in late April. I use an improved variety, about 1.5 kg seed per mu. Cotton needs deep soil, so I plough those 2 mu first. I put 60 jin of compound fertilizer per mu as base. When flowering starts, I add 20 jin of urea and 20 jin of potassium chloride per mu. That is about 13 kg nitrogen, 5 kg phosphorus, and 7 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate three times: at planting, at flowering, and at boll stage. Cotton needs many sprays. Last year I sprayed four times and the bollworm still got in. This year I will spray five times from July to August. Each spray costs money, but losing cotton costs more. I hope for 260 kg of seed cotton per mu.

I do not read books. I do what my neighbors do, and I do what I did last year. I would rather spend an extra 100 yuan on fertilizer than risk a bad harvest. My family needs the wheat for food, the maize for the pig and for selling, and the cotton for cash income.
